title: the drums drop, the vocal loop stays, the ring breathes
story: Push The Feeling On at 123 BPM: a four-on-the-floor house pre-roll, one ring per bar, the kick punching the field of view on every beat and the open hats flashing on the offbeats. At 5497 the drums drop out and the room darkens at 5513 (rms 0.065 to 0.030); the camera loops with the vocal, restarting each bar, and the ring is reborn on each bar's accent (5598, 5661, 5723) with a brightness lift. The drums return at 5747 and every beat punches again while the camera cuts every two bars through new stations, the hue swaying each half bar.
